description: Venue attributes for the 3D replays. Numbers come from the cited Wikipedia revision (infobox) or, for wall heights, the quoted sentence; null means the source does not state it. Tiers, bowl shape and EPL stand heights are not published consistently, so they are null and the replay draws a schematic bowl scaled by capacity.
